description: Keep Helm chart dependencies, Kubernetes/k3s versions, and CI tools pinned and updated.

customManagers.description: Update tools annotated with # renovate: datasource=... depName=... in CI workflows
Update versions annotated with # renovate: in mise.toml (non-mise tools such as helm plugins)
Pinned mise binary version in CI workflows and the devcontainer
Update k3s kubernetesVersion in installation cluster files

koorikla/platform app-container.yaml commit Kyverno trusts for keyless signatures (kyverno-policies imageVerification.github.workflowRef, tracks tag ci-v1); bump together with the app repos' `uses: koorikla/platform/.github/workflows/app-*.yaml@<sha> # ci-v1.0.0`
CAPG (charts/cluster gcp): provider version and the pinned manager image, bumped together
CAPG provider version (InfrastructureProvider gcp spec.version); grouped with its manager image
Crossplane packages (Functions, upjet family providers) pinned as xpkg.crossplane.io/<org>/<pkg>:<tag>@<digest> in addon crossplane; bump a provider family together (same tag for every member)

Platform Crossplane Configuration packages (packages/<name>, ghcr.io/koorikla/platform/<name>:<tag>@<digest>) in addon crossplane and per-installation/env pins: bumping the digest is the promotion (docs/crossplane.md)

packageRules.description: A Crossplane Project's Configuration and its embedded function (<name>_compose-<name>) are published by the same CI run and the Configuration's dependsOn pins the function digest: bump both in one PR

Mesh charts (addons/mesh: the four Istio charts from OCI ghcr.io/istio/release/charts + cert-manager-istio-csr): one PR. Helm cannot pin dependency digests, so the tarball sha256s in the Chart.yaml annotation platform.koorikla.io/dependency-digests move in the same PR (hack/deps.sh fails until they match)
prBodyNotes: Update `platform.koorikla.io/dependency-digests` in `addons/mesh/Chart.yaml`: `sha256sum addons/mesh/charts/*.tgz` after `helm dependency build addons/mesh` (Istio: = each chart's OCI layer digest; cross-check `crane manifest ghcr.io/istio/release/charts/<chart>:<version>`). CI fails until they match.
